# Reality Check

> Fluent Java 17+ assertion library. Zero dependencies. Drop-in `assertThat()`.
> Maven: `io.github.imetaxas:realitycheck-core`

## The one thing to know

```java
import static io.github.imetaxas.realitycheck.RealityAssertions.*;
// then use assertThat(anything) — it always routes to the right check type
```

## Dependency

```xml
<dependency>
    <groupId>io.github.imetaxas</groupId>
    <artifactId>realitycheck-core</artifactId>
    <version>1.0.0</version>
    <scope>test</scope>
</dependency>
```

## Core patterns

```java
// Strings
assertThat("hello").isNotEmpty().startsWith("he").hasLength(5);
assertThat("  ").isBlank();
assertThat("hello world").contains("world").matches("hello\\s\\w+");

// Numbers — int, long, double, float all work
assertThat(42).isPositive().isBetween(1, 100);
assertThat(3.14f).isCloseTo(3.15f, 0.01f);   // no within() wrapper needed

// Booleans
assertThat(flag).isTrue();

// Collections
assertThat(list).hasSize(3).contains("item").doesNotContain("other");
assertThat(list).containsExactly("a", "b", "c");
assertThat(list).allMatch(s -> !s.isBlank());          // label is optional
assertThat(list).anyMatch(s -> s.startsWith("USR-"), "user ID");

// Maps
assertThat(map).containsKey("name").containsEntry("name", "Alice");

// Optionals
assertThat(Optional.of("x")).isPresent().hasValue("x");

// Files
assertThat(path).exists().isRegularFile().hasExtension("json");

// URIs
assertThat(URI.create("https://api.example.com/v2?page=1"))
    .hasScheme("https").hasHost("api.example.com").hasQueryParam("page");

// Date/Time
assertThat(Instant.now().minusSeconds(60)).isInThePast();
assertThat(LocalDate.of(2026, 3, 31)).hasYear(2026).isWeekday();

// Exceptions
assertThatThrownBy(() -> Integer.parseInt("oops"))
    .isInstanceOf(NumberFormatException.class)
    .hasMessageContaining("oops");

// Enums — routes to EnumCheck automatically
assertThat(Status.ACTIVE).hasName("ACTIVE").hasOrdinal(0);
assertThat(status).isOneOf(Status.ACTIVE, Status.PENDING);

// Objects — generic fallback
assertThat(myObj).isNotNull().isInstanceOf(MyService.class);
assertThat(pojo).hasSameFieldsAs(expected);   // safe shallow field comparison

// Arrays
assertThat(new int[]{1, 2, 3}).hasLength(3).contains(2).isSorted();
assertThat(new float[]{0.1f, 0.5f}).hasLength(2).isSorted();

// Streams
assertThatStream(stream).hasSize(3).contains("b");

// Assertion label (shown in every failure message from this check)
assertThat(user.getName()).as("user name").isEqualTo("Alice");
// failure: [user name] expected: <Alice> but was: <Bob>
```

## Soft assertions — collect all failures

```java
assertAll(softly -> {
    softly.assertThat(name).as("name").isNotEmpty();
    softly.assertThat(age).as("age").isPositive();
    softly.assertThat(email).as("email").contains("@");
});
// On failure: Multiple failures (2): 1) [age] ... 2) [email] ...
```

## Custom failure message

```java
assertWithMessage("User must be active").that(user.getStatus()).isEqualTo(Status.ACTIVE);
```

## Custom check (3 lines)

```java
record MoneyCheck(Money actual, FailureHandler failureHandler)
        implements Check<MoneyCheck, Money> {
    public MoneyCheck self() { return this; }
    public MoneyCheck hasCurrency(String code) {
        return failureHandler.check(self(), actual.getCurrency().equals(code),
            "expected currency <%s> but was <%s>", code, actual.getCurrency());
    }
}
assertThat(payment, MoneyCheck::new).hasCurrency("USD");
```

## Modules

| Artifact | Adds |
|---|---|
| `realitycheck-core` | Everything above |
| `realitycheck-json` | `assertThatJson(str).fieldEquals("user.name", "Alice")` |
| `realitycheck-xml` | `assertThatXml(str).hasXPath("//user/name")` |
| `realitycheck-yaml` | `assertThatYaml(str).pathEquals("server.port", 8080)` |
| `realitycheck-snapshot` | `assertThatSnapshot(obj).matchesSnapshot("test","key")` |
| `realitycheck-junit5` | `@WithSoftChecks` — JUnit 5 parameter injection |
| `realitycheck-bom` | Version alignment for multi-module use |

## Type routing (for agents)

`assertThat(x)` routes automatically — agents do not need to pick the right entry point:

| Input type | Returns |
|---|---|
| `String` | `StringCheck` |
| `int / long / double / float` | `NumberCheck<T>` |
| `boolean` | `BooleanCheck` |
| `Collection<T>` | `CollectionCheck<T>` |
| `Map<K,V>` | `MapCheck<K,V>` |
| `Optional<T>` | `OptionalCheck<T>` |
| `Path / File` | `FileCheck` |
| `URI` | `UriCheck` |
| `int[] / long[] / double[] / float[] / byte[]` | primitive array checks |
| `E extends Enum<E>` | `EnumCheck<E>` |
| any other reference type | `ObjectCheck<T>` |
